mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE is_vip = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_question WHERE state = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user_practice_record WHERE DATE(submit_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM withdraw_record WHERE status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE IFNULL(is_read, 0) = 0
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM tb_vip_order WHERE pay_status = 1 AND pay_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY)
SELECT 'VIP会员' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_user WHERE is_vip = 1 UNION ALL SELECT '普通用户' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_user WHERE IFNULL(is_vip, 0) != 1
SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(question_type, ''), '未知题型') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_question WHERE state = 1 GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(question_type, ''), '未知题型') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT CASE source_mode WHEN 'all' THEN '章节练习' WHEN 'wrong' THEN '错题重练' WHEN 'single' THEN '单题练习' ELSE IFNULL(source_mode, '其他') END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_user_practice_record GROUP BY source_mode ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, NULL AS amount FROM tb_user WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(submit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, NULL AS amount FROM tb_user_practice_record WHERE submit_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(submit_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM tb_vip_order WHERE pay_status = 1 AND pay_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(pay_time) ORDER BY date ASC
